messages:
mira: quick sync? working on a per-route quota preview in the role editor — want to surface estimated cost/limit impact for admin tokens and scoped roles. thinking: a lightweight simulation rather than running real tenant traffic.

alex: SG. what exact inputs do we want from the editor? routes + quota caps + role -> simulated qps?

mira: yeah: selected routes, throttle/quota values, and role bindings. preview should answer: will this role change cause quota breaches for any route, and approximate token cost delta.

sam: implementation idea: use routing-policy matrix + recent per-route traffic histograms to estimate. run a short synthetic simulation over a sampled hour window. keep it best-effort (±20%).

jamal: privacy note: we must avoid returning tenant-identifying spikes. aggregate-only, and no raw trace ids in preview. also watch metrics retention / cold-starts.

alex: agreed. anonymize and bucket by route pattern + time-of-day. we can reuse cost model from chargeback-service.

sam: minimal API sketch:
```
POST /api/v1/preview/quota
{
  "role": "dev-ops",
  "routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"],
  "window": "1h",
  "sample_pct": 5
}
```
returns estimated qps, 95p latency risk, monthly token delta.

mira: nice. how do we handle admin tokens that bypass routing tiers? previews should show affinity: if an admin token is used, some requests route to Dedicated and cost changes.

jamal: surface two columns: "effective with admin-token" and "effective without". keep UI language explicit. enterprise customers asked for that several times.

alex: telemetry caveat — our recent telemetry pipeline aggregates at 5m, but retention for raw events is 7d. previews that rely on >7d windows will be weak. add a UI hint.

srebot: FYI deploy note: preview API will need a read-only permission check to avoid accidental logs. also add rate-limit: 10 req/min per user.

console-ci: add feature flag: console.preview.quota.v1. plan dark-launch to 10% orgs then 50%. we can collect feedback events: preview_accepted / preview_ignored.

sam: rollout plan: (1) internal-only, (2) dark-launch to small tenants, (3) enable opt-in in UI, (4) full rollout after 2w telemetry. keep canary backout path.

mira: UX question: do we show a heatmap of routes vs roles or a compact list?

alex: heatmap is useful but heavy. start compact list with inline expand for heatmap per-route. saves screen real-estate.

jamal: also add a small confidence score per estimate (low/med/high) derived from sample size and retention window. critical for support triage.

sam: on the API debate: should preview be computed synchronously (fast estimate) or async job? synchronous ok if sample_pct small — <200ms target. heavy requests fallback to async with notification.

mira: agree. keep sync for interactive editor. async for batch role changes or >5 routes.

console-ci: adding telemetry hooks: preview.requested, preview.completed, preview.viewed. include anonymized sample_pct and window. no tenant ids.

srebot: make sure we do not enable previews for orgs with >100k qps production without throttles. add a guard.

alex: one more: store no preview outputs permanently. ephemeral only for session, unless user explicitly saves a 'simulation snapshot' — then require explicit audit log.

mira: action items: 1) sam/eng-run: prototype preview API + sample engine (eta 1 sprint). 2) alex/infra: confirm telemetry retention and add aggregation endpoint (eta 3 days). 3) jamal/ux: mock compact list + heatmap expand (eta 4 days). 4) console-ci: flag + telemetry events (eta this week).

sam: I'll start with a tiny PoC that reads histograms and runs synthetic request loop. will post code snippet once done.

mira: awesome — thanks. tagging follow-ups in product board. :thumbsup:
